<steps>If policy rules require a cancellation service fee (and the passenger's tier isn't exempt), call charge_fee on R3311 with category "cancellation_service_fee" for the correct amount before refunding.</steps>

<steps>Report to Marcus Bell exactly what was cancelled, what amount (if any) was refunded and by what method or why nothing was refunded, citing the specific policy basis (insurance status, fare class, timing, fee).</steps>
